unit.summary_zh: 早就打算好的事用 be going to，临时决定和主动帮忙用 will，对将来的猜测用 will 和 probably。学完后，你能和朋友约好周末做什么。

can_do.en: Can use be going to for plans and will for quick decisions, offers and predictions.
can_do.zh: 能用 be going to 说计划，用 will 说临时决定、主动提议和预测。

can_do.en: Can ask about and discuss plans for the weekend or holidays, and make simple arrangements.
can_do.zh: 能询问和讨论周末或假期的计划，并约定简单的安排。

can_do.en: Can understand simple spoken information about plans, times and arrangements.
can_do.zh: 能听懂关于计划、时间和安排的简单口头信息。

grammar_points.title_en: Future: be going to and will
grammar_points.title_zh: 将来的表达：be going to 和 will
grammar_points.pattern:
I'm going to visit my cousin. (plan)
I'll make the cake! (decision now / offer)
It'll probably rain. (prediction)
grammar_points.explanation_zh: be going to + 动词原形：说话之前就已经打算好的事。will + 动词原形（口语常缩写成 'll）：说话的这一刻才决定的事、主动提出帮忙、承诺，以及对将来的看法和猜测。看到眼前的迹象做判断时，常用 be going to（Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.）。

examples.en: We're going to paint the kitchen this weekend.
examples.zh: 我们这个周末打算刷厨房。

examples.en: I think it'll be sunny tomorrow.

common_errors.wrong: I going to visit my cousin.
common_errors.right: I'm going to visit my cousin.
common_errors.why_zh: be going to 里的 be（am / is / are）不能省。
will 后面直接跟动词，不加 to。

vocabulary.example_en: What are you doing this weekend?
I'm going to start early tomorrow.
She's going to start a new job next week.
vocabulary.example_zh: 她下周要开始新工作了。

vocabulary.example_en: I'm going to visit my cousin.

vocabulary.zh: 我会；我来（I will 的缩写）

vocabulary.example_en: I'll book a table for six.
I'll pick you up at seven.
Maybe it'll be fine in the afternoon.

objectives.en: Talk about plans with be going to.
objectives.zh: 能用 be going to 说自己的计划。

steps.body_zh: 周五下午，大家都在聊周末打算做什么。已经想好、安排好的事，英语常用 be going to + 动词原形：I'm going to visit my cousin.。这节课学怎么说自己的计划，也学怎么问别人。

steps.instructions_zh: 先听。注意 going to 前面的 am / is / are。
steps.scene_zh: 周五下午，Lin 和同事 Sam 在收拾东西准备下班。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Any plans for the weekend, Lin?
lines.zh: Lin，周末有什么安排吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to visit my cousin in Hangzhou.
lines.zh: 有。我打算去杭州看我表妹。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Nice! How are you going to get there?
lines.zh: 不错！你打算怎么去？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I'm going to take the fast train on Saturday morning.
lines.zh: 我打算周六上午坐高铁去。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Are you going to stay with her?
lines.zh: 你住她那儿吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Yes, for one night. What about you? Are you free this weekend?
lines.zh: 嗯，住一晚。你呢？这个周末有空吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Not really. I'm going to paint my kitchen. It's going to take all weekend!
lines.zh: 不太有空。我要刷厨房，得花整个周末！

steps.question_zh: going to 前面总有什么词？后面的动词是什么形式？

examples.en: I'm going to visit my cousin.
Sam is going to paint his kitchen.
Are you going to stay with her?

steps.takeaway_zh: am / is / are + going to + 动词原形。be 动词随主语变（I'm，he's，we're），不能省。提问把 be 提到主语前，否定在 be 后面加 not。

steps.prompt_en: I ___ going to visit my cousin.
steps.explanation_zh: 主语 I 用 am：I am (I'm) going to ...
be going to + 动词原形，to 不能少。

answers: Are you going to stay with her?
steps.explanation_zh: Are + 主语 + going to + 动词原形？

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，说话人什么时候开始新工作？
steps.audio_en: I'm going to start a new job next week.
steps.explanation_zh: next week = 下周。

steps.prompt_zh: 回想对话：Lin 周六怎么去杭州？
steps.explanation_zh: I'm going to take the fast train：坐高铁。

steps.sentence_en: "What are you going to do this weekend?" "I ___ going to see a film."
steps.translation_zh: “你这周末打算做什么？”“我打算去看电影。”
steps.explanation_zh: I + am + going to ...，口语里常缩写成 I'm。

steps.prompt_en: They ___ going to buy a car.
steps.explanation_zh: 主语 they 用 are。

objectives.en: Use will for decisions made now and for offers.
objectives.zh: 能用 will 说当下的决定和主动提出的帮忙。

objectives.en: Choose between be going to (planned) and will (decided now).
objectives.zh: 能区分 be going to（早有计划）和 will（现在才决定）。

steps.body_zh: 朋友说“蛋糕还没着落呢”，你马上接一句“我来做！”——这种说话当下才做的决定、主动帮忙，英语用 will：I'll make one!。这节课学 will 的这种用法，并和上节课的 be going to 对比。

steps.instructions_zh: 先听。注意谁用了 going to，谁用了 I'll。
steps.scene_zh: Lin 和室友 Kate 在商量给朋友 Mia 过生日。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: It's Mia's birthday on Friday. Are you going to do anything?
lines.zh: 周五是 Mia 的生日。你打算做点什么吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to cook dinner for her. But I need a cake.
lines.zh: 嗯，我打算给她做顿晚饭。不过还缺个蛋糕。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: Don't worry. I'll make one! I love baking.
lines.zh: 别担心，我来做！我很喜欢烘焙。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Really? Thanks! I'll buy the drinks, then.
lines.zh: 真的吗？谢谢！那饮料我来买。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: Should we invite Jack too?
lines.zh: 要不要也请 Jack？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Good idea. I'll text him now.
lines.zh: 好主意，我现在就给他发消息。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: And I'll book a karaoke room for after dinner.
lines.zh: 我再订个 KTV 包间，吃完饭去。

steps.explanation_zh: 说话之前就打算好的事用 be going to；说话这一刻才决定的事、主动提出帮忙、答应别人，用 will。口语里 I will 几乎总说成 I'll。will 后面直接跟动词原形，所有人称都一样，不加 to，也不加 -s。否定是 won't（will not）。
steps.pattern: I'll + 动词原形：I'll make one. / I'll text him now.

examples.en: I'm going to cook dinner for her. (planned)
examples.zh: 我打算给她做晚饭。（早就打算好）

examples.en: I'll buy the drinks, then. (decided now)
examples.zh: 那饮料我来买。（当下决定）

examples.en: That bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.
examples.zh: 那个包看着很重，我来拿吧。

tips_zh: 听到 Don't worry、Good idea、then 后面接 I'll，通常是当场做决定。
won't 读作 /wəʊnt/，和 want 的读音不一样。

steps.prompt_zh: 朋友这么说，你想主动帮忙：
options: I carried it for you tomorrow.
I carry it for you last night.
steps.explanation_zh: 当下主动提出帮忙用 I'll + 动词原形。

steps.prompt_zh: 你上个月就决定暑假去云南，票也买好了。朋友问 What are your plans for the summer?，最合适的回答是：
options: I'm going to travel to Yunnan.
I travelled to Yunnan next summer.
steps.explanation_zh: 早就决定好的计划用 be going to。I'll travel ... 听起来像是你刚刚才决定。

steps.instructions_zh: 把朋友说的话和你的回应配对。

pairs.right: I'll buy some on the way home.

steps.explanation_zh: 答应别人用 will（口语常说 I'll help you）。

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，说话人要买什么？
steps.audio_en: Thanks! I'll buy the drinks, then.
steps.explanation_zh: I'll buy the drinks：饮料我来买。

steps.task_zh: 朋友周六要搬家，事情很多。主动提出 3 种帮忙，每种都用 I'll ... 开头。
steps.prompt_en: I'm moving flat on Saturday and I have so much to do!
model_answers: Don't worry, I'll help you! I'll bring some boxes on Friday. I'll pick you up at nine on Saturday. And I'll buy lunch for everyone.
checklist_zh: 至少 3 句 I'll + 动词原形
用了 Don't worry 或类似的话安慰对方

steps.explanation_zh: I'll + 动词原形 + 宾语 + 时间。
Kate 说 I'll make one! I love baking.

objectives.en: Make predictions with will, probably and I think.
objectives.zh: 能用 will、probably、I think 对将来做预测。

objectives.en: Use be going to when you can see something is about to happen.
objectives.zh: 能在看到眼前的迹象时用 be going to 做判断。

steps.body_zh: 约人出去玩，总要先看看天气。对将来的看法和猜测，英语常用 will，再加上 probably（很可能）、I think（我觉得）让语气更自然。要是已经看到乌云压顶，就用 be going to：It's going to rain!

steps.instructions_zh: 先听。注意他们对天气的猜测。
steps.scene_zh: Lin 和 Sam 在公园散步，商量周末去野餐。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Let's have a picnic here on Sunday.
lines.zh: 我们周日来这儿野餐吧。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Hmm. The forecast says it'll rain on Sunday.
lines.zh: 嗯……天气预报说周日会下雨。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Really? I think it'll be fine in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 真的吗？我觉得下午会好的。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Maybe. But it'll probably be cold.
lines.zh: 也许吧。但很可能会冷。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: OK, let's go on Saturday, then. Saturday will be sunny.
lines.zh: 好吧，那就周六去。周六会是晴天。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Great. Oh, look at those dark clouds! It's going to rain now.
lines.zh: 太好了。哎，看那些乌云！马上要下雨了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Quick, let's go inside!
lines.zh: 快，我们进去吧！

steps.question_zh: 哪些句子是“我觉得会……”，哪一句是“眼看就要……”？

examples.en: I think it'll be fine in the afternoon.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.

steps.takeaway_zh: 预测和看法用 will（常和 I think、probably 一起）。probably 放在 will 后面、won't 前面：It'll probably rain. / It probably won't rain.。“我觉得不会”英语习惯说 I don't think it'll ...。已经看到眼前的迹象时，用 be going to。

steps.explanation_zh: I think + will + 动词原形：表示看法和预测。
will + probably + 动词原形，也可以缩写成 It'll probably be cold.

steps.prompt_en: Look at the sky! It ___ rain.
steps.prompt_zh: 天已经全黑了，乌云密布。选出最合适的：
steps.explanation_zh: 看到眼前的迹象做判断，用 be going to。
英语习惯把否定放在 think 上：I don't think it'll ...

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，明天天气怎么样？
steps.audio_en: The forecast says it'll be windy and cold tomorrow.
steps.explanation_zh: windy and cold：有风，很冷。

steps.prompt_zh: 回想对话：他们最后决定哪天去野餐？
steps.explanation_zh: let's go on Saturday, then. Saturday will be sunny.

steps.task_zh: 给朋友写一条消息（4–5 句），约她周末一起做一件事：说你的计划（be going to），说说你对天气或人多不多的预测（will / probably），最后问她要不要来。
model_answers: Hi Anna! I'm going to walk up Purple Mountain on Saturday morning. The forecast says it'll be sunny, but it'll probably be busy, so I'm going to leave early. Do you want to come with me?
checklist_zh: 至少一句 be going to 说计划
至少一句 will / probably 做预测
will 和 going to 后面都是动词原形
最后有一个邀请的问题

steps.explanation_zh: I don't think + 主语 + will + 动词原形。
will 后面用动词原形，will 本身也不加 -s。

objectives.en: Understand times and arrangements in a phone call.
objectives.zh: 能听懂电话里的时间和安排。

objectives.en: Make an arrangement with a friend using going to and will.
objectives.zh: 能用 going to 和 will 和朋友约好一件事。

steps.body_zh: 先听 Lin 和 Mia 打电话约周六，抓住时间和谁负责什么；然后分清 going to 和 will 的用法；最后轮到你约朋友。

steps.instructions_zh: 听两遍。注意时间和谁要做什么。
steps.scene_zh: 周四晚上，Mia 给 Lin 打电话。

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: Hi Lin! Are you free on Saturday?
lines.zh: 嗨 Lin！你周六有空吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: In the morning I'm going to help my mum. But I'm free after two.
lines.zh: 上午我要帮我妈做事，不过两点以后有空。

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: Great. There's a new art show in the city centre. Do you want to come?
lines.zh: 太好了。市中心有个新的艺术展，你想去吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I'd love to. How are we going to get there?
lines.zh: 很想去。我们怎么去？

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: I'll drive. I'll pick you up at half past two.
lines.zh: 我开车，两点半来接你。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Perfect. Will it be busy?
lines.zh: 太好了。人会多吗？

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: Probably. It's the first weekend. I'll book tickets online tonight.
lines.zh: 很可能会，这是第一个周末。我今晚在网上订票。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Thanks! I'll buy us coffee after the show.
lines.zh: 谢谢！看完展我请你喝咖啡。

steps.prompt_zh: Lin 周六上午要做什么？
steps.explanation_zh: In the morning I'm going to help my mum.
half past two = 两点半。

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，Mia 今晚要做什么？
steps.explanation_zh: book tickets online：在网上订票。

steps.instructions_zh: 这些句子分别是哪种用法？

pairs.left: I'm going to help my mum.
Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.

steps.sentence_en: How ___ we going to get there?
steps.explanation_zh: 主语 we 用 are：How are we going to ...?

steps.task_zh: 朋友问你这个周末做什么。说说你的计划（going to），约对方一起做一件事，主动提出负责一部分（I'll ...），再猜一猜天气或人多不多（will / probably）。
steps.prompt_en: Hey, what are you doing this weekend?
model_answers: I'm going to visit the new bookshop on Sunday. Do you want to come? I'll pick you up at ten. It'll probably be busy, so let's go early.
checklist_zh: 用 going to 说了计划
发出了邀请（Do you want to come?）
用 I'll 主动提出做一件事
用 will / probably 做了一个预测

steps.task_zh: 朋友发邮件请你周六去她家吃饭。写一封简短的回信（3–4 句）：接受邀请，说你会带什么（I'll bring ...），并问一个关于时间或地点的问题。
model_answers: Hi Jenny, thanks for the invitation! I'd love to come on Saturday. I'll bring a dessert. What time are you going to start dinner?
checklist_zh: 用 I'll bring ... 说你会带什么
问了一个关于时间或地点的问题

steps.sentence_en: I think the show ___ be great.
steps.explanation_zh: I think + will：表示看法和预测。

steps.prompt_en: "Oh no, I left my wallet at home!"
steps.prompt_zh: 朋友没带钱包，你最自然的回应是：
options: Don't worry, I pay last week.
steps.explanation_zh: 当场主动提出帮忙：I'll pay.
